faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SRTIP Free Zone. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.a: SRTIP (Sharjah Research Technology and Innovation Park) is a purpose-built free zone for technology, research, and innovation-driven businesses. It offers low-cost setup, 100% foreign ownership, and quick licensing within 3-7 working days.
SRTIP is located in Sharjah, UAE — adjacent to American University of Sharjah. It provides excellent connectivity to Dubai and other emirates with easy access to major highways and airports.

items.q: What is included in the SRTIP setup package?
items.a: Depending on the package, you get the Free Zone license, residency visa, medical & Emirates ID, lease agreement, bank account assistance, premium address, and free VAT consultation.

items.q: How much does an SRTIP package cost?
items.a: Our SRTIP packages start from AED 5,999 (Economy) and go up to AED 16,999 (Mainland + Residency). Premium packages with visa start at AED 14,499.
Typically 3-7 working days for license issuance, and additional 1-2 weeks for visa processing and bank account opening.
Yes. All packages are starting points and can be customized to match your tech business, visa needs, and budget.

items.q: Do I get a UAE residency visa?
items.a: Yes, select packages include a UAE investor/residency visa with medical, Emirates ID, and status change. The Free Zone License with Lifetime UAE Residency even offers lifetime residency.
Yes. All packages include free assistance with corporate bank account opening at top UAE banks.

items.q: What tech activities can I do?
items.a: SRTIP supports research & development, technology & innovation, life sciences, renewable energy, advanced materials, digital solutions, and other innovation-driven industries — with up to 5 activities in most economy packages.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for SRTIP setup?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, tech industry expertise, dedicated consultants, and end-to-end support — from license to visa to bank account. All with 10,000+ successful setups.
